task.ques: Browse the ArXiv store and let me know how many different types of merchandise are available.

claude.final_answer: FINAL: The official arXiv store offers 6 merchandise types: baseball caps, short-sleeve T-shirts, long-sleeve T-shirts, pullover hoodies, coffee mugs, and large coffee mugs. The store labels these as Printed Classic Baseball Cap, Premium Unisex Tee, Premium Long Sleeve Tee, Midweight Pullover Hoodie, Coffee Mug, and Large Coffee Mug, all visible in final.png. Source: https://www.bonfire.com/store/arxiv-official/ (checked October 27, 2026).
